Custom prototype score, not a credit score or validated financial assessment. Monthly forecasts use opening November balances; future balances are not rolled forward yet. No live market data or GPT-generated advice.

A score you can unpack.

This is Wealthloom’s custom prototype formula, not a validated assessment. It highlights what to explore—not how you compare with other people.

Targets and weights are demo assumptions. Source groups do not prove independent risk. When inputs are missing, the score is unavailable. Values are calculated in code; GPT does not assign scores.
